Bay Area Persian DJ, Iran Event Services in the Bay Area

Elevate your wedding, party, or cultural event with the dynamic energy of the Bay Area’s premier Persian DJ team. We specialize in creating unforgettable experiences by blending authentic Iranian music, international hits, and bilingual MCing to entertain guests from all generations and regions—including Kurdish, Gilaki, Mazandarani, Lur, Tat, Talysh, Baloch, and more.

Experience You Can Trust

With years of experience across Northern California, our team has performed at prominent venues such as:

  • Piedmont Community Center (Wedding Reception, 2013)
  • Blackhawk Museum (Danville, 2012)
  • Blackhawk Country Club (San Ramon)
  • Nowroz Festival in Pleasanton (featuring Persian & Afghani music with DJ & Photo Booth services)

Musical Expertise & Playlist Highlights


Our repertoire includes both classic and remix versions of beloved Persian tracks, such as:

  • “Aroosi” — Sharareh
  • “Black Cats – Jooneh Khodet” and “Majnoon”
  • “Temptation,” “Donya” — Arash & Benyamin
  • Hits by Shahram Solati, Leila Forouhar, Hamed Homayoun, Eddie Attar, Mansour, Afshin, Andy Madadian, Googoosh, and many others
  • Vigen Shah Doomad I. Hayedeh Shabeh Esghe J. Vigen Simin Bari K. Leila Forouhar Aroosi L. Shohreh Solati Aas M. Sharareh Aroosi N. Temptation – Arash O. DONYA – BENYAMIN PERSIAN P. Hamine Ke Hast – Mohammad Alizadeh Q. Be Kasi Nagoo – Andy Silk Road R. Wedding baba karam dance – Persian S. Areh Areh – Andy Madadian T. Mobarak bada – persian wedding song U. Aseh Aseh – Sheila Cheshmoone Man V. Ostad – Sasy W. Dast Bezan – Mazyar Fallahi Dast Bezan X. Chenin Konam Chenan Konam – Hamed Homayoun Y. Meshki Lebas – Bax Meshki Lebas Z. Azizam – Eddie Attar A1. Bi Hashiyeh – Shahab Tiam A2. Aroose Khalij – Sheila Cheshmoone Man A3. Mansour Mansour A4. Persian Wedding Song Iranian Wedding Song & Traditions.

Why Choose Us?

  • Versatile Music Coverage: From old-school Persian staples to modern remixes across genres.
  • Bilingual Bilingual MC/DJ: Fluent in Farsi and English to engage every guest.
  • Culturally Connected: Music selections rooted in Persian heritage, perfect for weddings, festivals, and private parties alike.

Let Us Make Your Event Unforgettable


Whether you’re planning a Persian wedding, engagement, cultural celebration, or any special event in the Bay Area, our talented team is ready to deliver a vibrant and personalized musical experience. From traditional entrance songs to non-stop dance hits, we’ve got your soundtrack covered.
